feature_contract.goal: Translate source-authored D3D9 SM3 SETP p0 comparisons and loop BREAKP into native D3D11 VS/PS HLSL control flow for guarded full-resolution game Draw/DrawIndexed, with conservative predicate lifetime merges, DX9Ex input/render fallback and no claim of measured game native pixels.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: D3D9 SM3 SETP/BREAKP parse and emit native HLSL predicate and conditional break along the existing D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed shader-object path.
Reject BREAKP before SETP/outside REP, invalid predicate tokens and conditional-only writes; preserve original D3D9 rendering/gamepad/FFB and DXVK freeze.
Portable predicate flow C++ positive/negative regression, source integration, and required Fast/Backend/Win32/OpenXR/HUD GitHub checks pass on the same final validation SHA.

integration_path: Intercept and decode the game's shader-bound D3D9 programmable VS/PS instruction streams
Track SETP p0 definite initialization across IF/ELSE/ENDIF and nested REP/BREAK without fabricating state
Emit predicate HLSL for native D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed while preserving fail-closed fallback
Verify full exact-SHA five-Gate suite; actual game and Quest3 evidence remains separate
